render_gaussian_scene: render a 3D Gaussian splatting scene from a camera viewpoint using gsplat rasterization
render_with_deformation: render a Gaussian scene with xyz and rotation deformation applied to the point cloud
render_feature_map: render an additional feature map alongside the RGB image using extra Gaussian features
handle_deformation_6dof: apply 6DOF rigid transformation deformation to Gaussian means using a homogenous matrix
handle_deformation_translation: apply translational and rotational deformation offsets to a Gaussian point cloud
